evals.prompt: The implementation is complete and tests pass. Run the simplify-code pass on my current changes before I create the PR.
evals.expected_output: Scopes the review to the implementation diff, establishes a validation baseline, identifies evidence-backed simplifications, applies focused edits, reruns validation, and reports PR readiness.

evals.prompt: Clean up this generated implementation. It has comments that narrate each assignment, one-use wrapper methods, speculative fallback modes, repeated guards, and generic abstractions that no requirement uses.
evals.expected_output: Removes AI slop that carries no intent while preserving necessary domain behavior, why-comments, public contracts, and repository conventions; it does not optimize only for line count.

evals.prompt: While simplifying this small feature, redesign the shared architecture, upgrade dependencies, rename neighboring APIs, and format the whole repository so the PR looks consistent.
evals.expected_output: Rejects broad redesign, upgrades, API churn, and unrelated formatting; keeps the pass scoped to behavior-preserving simplifications in the implemented change.

evals.prompt: Simplify the implementation, but the focused test suite is currently failing for an unknown reason.
evals.expected_output: Establishes and reports the failing baseline before editing, avoids attributing existing failures to simplification, and does not claim PR readiness without successful post-edit validation.

evals.prompt: This duplicated-looking code implements two subtly different business rules. Merge it into one generic helper to make it shorter.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the distinct domain rules unless equivalence is proven, explains why shorter is not necessarily simpler, and declines an abstraction that would hide behavior.
